The two '''Imperial artificial asteroids''' were space stations disguised as [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. They housed military personnel and material, including [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] and several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[field stormtrooper]]s. During the [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] of [[Altyr V]], the Imperial invasion forces were dispatched from the two asteroids. [[Kyle Katarn]] infiltrated and destroyed the asteroids, effectively ensuring a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] victory.
